app.name: Rooms
app.summary: A room on a tile: its name with an icon or picture, and its lights, plugs and switches to tap.
app.title: Title
app.title_hint: The room's name at the top. Empty takes the tile's name, else the area's.
app.icon_hint: Beside the title. Auto picks one from the title or the area. A picture of the tile's own entity (an image, a camera or a person) takes its place.
app.area_hint: The id of a Home Assistant area, such as living_room (Settings, Areas: the end of its address). Its lights, switches, fans and toggles are added under the ones below.
app.skip_hint: Entities of the area whose id or name holds one of these words stay off the tile, such as child_lock.
app.entity_hint: A light, switch, fan or toggle. These come first, in this order.
